title: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (EU) 2025/40
notes: Held as a record specifically so it is not mistaken for a passport instrument again. The word 'passport' appears twice in the entire Regulation and both occurrences point outward: where the packaged product is covered by Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 or other Union law requiring a digital product passport, THAT passport should also carry the information required here. So there is no packaging passport, and a packaging product group would have nothing to dispatch on — no passport, no schema derived from law, no determination possible. What the Regulation does require is labelling, and a QR code or other standardised open data carrier on reusable packaging carrying re-use system and trip data, which is a data-carrier obligation. A trade-press claim that this created a packaging passport from 2028-08-12 was recorded once and refuted by reading the primary text. Deliberately unbound and parked pending a decision to revisit.
